# Myrddin at work: history, archives & records, astrology, tarot & esoteric services, and the myths that got there first

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Myrddin** works now.

Myrddin's dossier divides in two, and the tradition itself knew it: the northern prophet who went mad at Arfderydd and fled to Coed Celyddon, preserved in the Welsh Triads, the Annales Cambriae, and the Black Book poems; and Geoffrey of Monmouth's Merlinus, who carried the wild man into Latin and grafted him onto the Arthurian world. Gerald of Wales already separated them in the twelfth century: Merlinus Ambrosius, the boy prophet of Vortigern's tower, and Merlinus Celidonius — Sylvester — the wild man of the Caledonian forest.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Myrddin
- **Pantheon:** Celtic
- **Domain of influence:** Seer, Wild Man
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** History, Archives & Records
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 244 of 406

## The Myth at Work

**The Battle of Arfderydd.** The Annales Cambriae enter under the year 573 the battle of Arfderydd, fought in the north between the sons of Eliffer and Gwenddolau son of Ceidio — a historical-seeming conflict of the British Old North.  The Welsh Triads count it among the futile battles of the Island of Britain, brought about, in the triad's famous understatement, for a lark's nest; and the triad records the consequence that matters here: Gwenddolau fell, and Myrddin became mad. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Apple Trees and the Oianau.** The earliest Welsh manuscript, the Black Book of Carmarthen (c.  1250), preserves the poems that give the wild man his own voice. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### History, Archives & Records

*Museums, archives, libraries, and the record-keeping professions. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The Vita Merlini and the Black Book prophecies — the Welsh Merlin before the romances claimed him.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The wild prophet of the Caledonian forest — prophecy spoken from the trees.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Myrddin performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Forestry, Conservation & Outdoor Industries

*Forestry, wildlife protection, and outdoor recreation. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The forest as sanctuary and sentence — the woods of Celyddon, his kingdom of madmen.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Myrddin performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

## The Long Employment

No Celtic figure has had a stranger second life.  Geoffrey's Prophetiae Merlini — the seventh book of the Historia — circulated separately for centuries and became the most copied political prophecy of the Latin Middle Ages, mined for omens by kings and rebels alike; the romances then turned the prophet into the enchanter, and by the thirteenth-century Vulgate cycle Merlin is Arthur's maker: arranger of Uther's night at Tintagel, keeper of the Round Table's founding, and prisoner of the Lady of the Lake. The age changed. The work did not.

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

If you work in history, archives & records, astrology, tarot & esoteric services, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it.
